piece.headline: ANUJ TAKES THE CROWN WITH A MONSTER WEEK
piece.standfirst: Anuj posted the week's best score and took top spot. Sukrut's 2-week lead is gone, and Aary had the week's lowest score.
piece.big_picture: Anuj takes the lead, 16 points clear of Prerana. Sukrut had 2 weeks on top and now sits 3rd. Prerana is next in line, and 16 points is a gap she could close.
piece.decision_of_the_week: Sudev picked the wrong 11 in the week he played his Wildcard. 21 points stayed on the bench, the most in the league. A fresh squad needs a sharper team sheet.
piece.one_to_watch: Aary and Omkar are split by 1 point on the Tin Pot line. One good captain pick could decide who climbs clear and who gets stuck down there.

winners.name: Anuj
winners.verdict: The week's best score and the lead to go with it. Everyone else is now chasing Anuj.

winners.name: Prerana
winners.verdict: The only one to captain Gibbs-White, and it paid off. Lone-wolf nerve, and it lifted her to 2nd.

winners.name: Atharva Kshirsagar
winners.verdict: Up to 10th, the biggest leap in the top half. A 13-point bench stopped it being even bigger.

losers.name: Aary
losers.verdict: Captained B.Fernandes alone and he returned 2. A rough week, but the lowest score of the round is a single bad week, not a verdict.

losers.name: Rushikesh
losers.verdict: Took a 4-point hit for Gonzalo and Saka. The hit bought no joy, and 10 more points sat on the bench.

losers.name: Omkar
losers.verdict: Not a chip in sight and no captain gamble. The points just never turned up.

ratings.l: Top score, top spot. 10 points sat on the bench, so it could have been even bigger.
